fields.name: LightColor0
fields.evidence: Slot 4 xyz, programs 20052 and 17163 (skin, hair): the colour paired with the world-space light direction (slot 23) in the diffuse term, so it is the main light colour.

fields.name: SunColor
fields.evidence: Slot 5 xyz, program 6183: multiplied by the lit terms in both branches of the flag that selects the light path; the sweep gave a small effect. The main light colour.

fields.name: PointLightPosition0
fields.evidence: Slot 7 xyz: view-space vector (slot - fragment view position) is squared and summed, inverse-sqrt normalised and dotted with the normal: a point light position.

fields.name: PointLightColor0
fields.evidence: Slot 8 xyz: multiplies the first point light's lit terms.

fields.name: LightDirectionWorld
fields.evidence: Slot 23 xyz, negated and dotted with the world normal; same slot as TotK LightDir0World (WildRenderingSharp).

fields.name: ShadowBias
fields.evidence: Slot 55 .w: added to the clamped light term before the final clamp.

fields.name: ShadowScale
fields.evidence: Slot 56 .y: multiplier on two lit terms near the end of program 6183.

fields.name: SkinAmbientScale
fields.evidence: Slot 59 .x, program 20052: fma(x, 0.667, 1) and fma(x, 0.818, 1), a pair of lighting gains.

fields.name: DepthBias
fields.evidence: Slot 60 .zw: w - z is added to a value read from a depth storage buffer.

fields.name: TerminatorRamp
fields.evidence: Slot 61 .xy: ((x term) - .x) * .y clamped, a light ramp.

fields.name: ProbeFlags
fields.evidence: Slot 64 zw: compared with zero and tested with isnan to switch the probe paths; zero turns them off.

fields.name: ProbeColor
fields.evidence: Slot 65 xyz: copied into colour-like temporaries before the ambient terms.

fields.name: ProbeBoxScale
fields.evidence: Slot 66 xyz: fma(position, z, 1), and the negated y, fma(position, x, -y): a scale and offset of a position, the probe box.

fields.name: ProbeOffsetSecond
fields.evidence: Slot 67 w: the same shape as slot 112 w (fma(direction, w, position)), used by the second probe.

fields.name: AmbientScale
fields.evidence: Slot 68 .x: multiplies slot 70 and enters fma(x, .., 1) twice.

fields.name: ShadowTint
fields.evidence: Slot 69 .xy, program 20052: (y - 1) * x, a blend toward a shadow tint.

fields.name: AmbientColor
fields.evidence: Slot 70 xyz: times slot 68 .x, times two lit terms.

fields.name: PointLightColor2
fields.evidence: Slot 71 xyz, program 17163 (hair): multiplies the third point light's term.

fields.name: PointLightPosition2
fields.evidence: Slot 72 xyz, program 17163: negated and added to the view-space position like slots 7 and 87, a third point light position.

fields.name: HemiSky
fields.evidence: Slot 73 xyz: lerp(slot 74, slot 73, normal.y*0.5+0.5), so it is the colour of the up direction.

fields.name: HemiGround
fields.evidence: Slot 74 xyz: the lerp origin, the colour of the down direction.

fields.name: LightVolume
fields.evidence: Slot 75: xyz + w * world position is the coordinate sampled from a 3D texture (a light volume): xyz offset, w scale.

fields.name: LightVolumeBlend
fields.evidence: Slot 76: .w and .z/.x/.y scale terms of the sampled volume colour.

fields.name: SpecularBias
fields.evidence: Slot 79 .x: added to the negated y term of a normal.

fields.name: SkinRamp
fields.evidence: Slot 80, programs 20052 and 17163: fma(x, .w, .z) + .y remaps a lit term; .x also scales a lit term near the end.

fields.name: SkinScales
fields.evidence: Slot 81: .x fma(c, x, 1) gain on three colour terms, .y and .z scale later terms.

fields.name: SurfaceScales
fields.evidence: Slot 82: .x scales three colour channels before a max against the light sum (this is what whitens hair when large), .y a combined term, .w another (hair).

fields.name: SpecularScales
fields.evidence: Slot 83 .zw, program 20052: scale two specular terms.

fields.name: PointLightColor1
fields.evidence: Slot 86 xyz: multiplies the second point light, as slot 8 does the first.

fields.name: PointLightPosition1
fields.evidence: Slot 87 xyz: second point light position, used as slot 7 is.

fields.name: PointLightRange
fields.evidence: Slot 92 xyzw: attenuation terms of the point lights (offsets and scales added/multiplied on distance).

fields.name: PointLightRange1
fields.evidence: Slot 93 .xy: scales of the squared-distance terms.

fields.name: FroxelTint
fields.evidence: Slot 94 y: multiplies the context row 0..2 y components (a view-space direction) before the volume lookup; xyz read.

fields.name: FroxelNearFar
fields.evidence: Slot 95 xy: the view distance is clamped between x and y, then log2 of it picks the slice of the fog volumes (gsys user volumes read as extinction and in-scatter); also 1/x scales the distance into the extinction exponent.

fields.name: FroxelScale
fields.evidence: Slot 96 xyz: x and y scale the screen position (pixel * context resolution reciprocal) into the fog volumes u and v, z scales exp2 of the slice term into w.

fields.name: ReflectionLod
fields.evidence: Slot 97 .x: the level of detail of the environment cube map read and a roughness multiplier.

fields.name: ProbeOffset
fields.evidence: Slot 112 w: multiplied by a view-space direction and added to the position before the probe lookup, fma(direction, w, position): a probe parallax offset.

fields.name: DepthLimit
fields.evidence: Slot 113 .x: the integer minimum of the storage buffer value and this float's bits.
